en: Front: color postcard with an orange border showing a large stepped modernist spa hotel/sanatorium building set against wooded hills and a blue sky. Back: Romanian trade‑union postcard template with blue printed text, a blue 2 lei 'Poșta Română – Arta Populară' stamp, postal cancellations from Covasna and Brăila dated 1983, a printed description of the Covasna spa, and a handwritten message addressed to Brăila.
